Tendu/Paniqué explicitly delegate to Stress; DR, assistance and natural failure are separate stable section targets.
Do not merge Renommée with Réputation: the article explicitly distinguishes the two meanings.
PA spent in active defence and future passes refer to a procedure, not to a generic combat page. Encombrant is an equipment property.
A defence link should distinguish passive/active defence from armour reduction; Fiable is an equipment property with a narrow exception.
Viser, Verrouillage, Rafale and Suppression are distinct procedures and stable section targets. The words Portée and Altération need rules context.
PV thresholds impose minimum Stress. Agonisant and Stabilisé refer to separate steps; healing and recovery have different rules.
Natural failure ranges vary by state. Raison is explicitly not a generic gauge; avoid linking the word in ordinary contexts to a separate mechanic.
A generic famille mafieuse is not the proper faction La Famille. Origine and current Sphère must remain distinct.
Neurodiver and Neurodriver are explicitly different. Mechanical talent definitions live in Builder, so avoid inventing per-talent wiki pages from the principles article.
Unsinkable, Neurocompatibilité nulle and Mauvais tireur are described as examples; their effects point to distinct Neurodive, augmentation and firing rules.
Stress augmentique is a separate system from psychological Stress; N-Sta is an equipment item, not a general calm-down rule.
Slots belong to individual supports. CyberŒil, CyberAudio, cyberlimb and Biogénétique require different section targets; the word famille refers to technology classes, not a criminal faction.
Explicit definitions distinguish Neurodive, Neurodiver, Neurodriver and Unsinkable. An ordinary Holonet application is not a Neuroprogramme.
Intrusion and Contrôle are separate actions, as are Trace and Déconnexion. Route each reference to its procedure.
Corruption here is damage to a program, not the occult Corruption of Fléaux. The rules distinguish program corruption, sacrifice and destruction.
A price, the Compte, Train de vie and monthly Charges fixes are separate concepts. Corporate support is access rather than ownership. Dykal is not automatically converted to dollars.
Weapon property names should reach procedure anchors: Rafale, Suppression, Fiable, Zone. Armure and typed Réductions require distinct wording.
Neurodive control of a vehicle does not become Pilotage. Structure and Blindage apply to a vehicle, unlike PV and personal Armure.
The second section has no body: do not direct semantic links to it yet. PTV-funded abilities do not create equipment or network access by themselves.
Defence occulte uses Volonté and Force Mentale against direct effects on the mind or soul; Voir sous le Voile does not Révéler.
V/SR/R, companion actions, physical armour and alien interface compatibility are independent section targets. Section 9 has no body; avoid linking to that empty heading.
GT authorisation, Hunt status and Association infrastructure do not grant equipment. Link each designation to its section rather than to the whole hunter doctrine.
Nature, Cour d'origine, Sang noir and political allegiance are distinct. Five Court imprints have separate sections and free abilities.
Le texte réserve explicitement cette tradition aux Vampires : suppression du tag humain.
Each named Sang is a meaningful section target. The exceptional transformations are explicitly outside the ordinary 1–3 PTV catalogue.
The thirteen tradition pages contain 262 talents; with four common doctrine talents the total is 266. Tradition names should link to dedicated pages.
The three orders have distinct missions. Institutional resources are not Talents purchased with PTV.
The fictional Khālsā tradition addresses actual supernatural coercion, not all natural limitations or an ordinary use of the word liberty.
The Gu/Shimazu Yin-Yang tradition and the Shi Art of the Void are related but have different aims; a Qi disturbance is not automatic species identification.
Kabbale uses the Sephiroth as trained methods but does not turn hunters into Angelus or Sephirians.
The Djinn is a real companion; PTV buys the link, not the entity or an independent action pool.
Shikigami, seals, exorcism and consensual pacts are separate practices; Koji’s lightning is not generic.
Mystères are culturally distinct, not an interchangeable unified religion; an offering cannot invent a weakness.
Ranks are narrative and a Talent does not create a mount or vehicle.
True visions do not imply correct interpretation or a moral detector.
Xenoshield identifies material origins and incompatibilities, not alien guilt; an Extral can learn the doctrine.
Independent hunters share no institutional network; Héritages need a lived or transmitted origin.
Members are descendants, not reincarnated knights; Merlin weapons are unique physical artifacts, unlike Excalibur.
Garou forms are distinct from V/SR/R; Pelage is cultural, Sang vif is a lineage, Mue is timed and costly; Frénésie is not ordinary Stress.
The twelve Sangs vifs are distinct section targets; Sang Enchaîné is a special case without hybrid form.
Other Khinae lineages share Mue but do not inherit Garou Meute or Pelage features. Animal variant and Sang vif are separate choices; many lineage sections deserve direct anchors.
Mage Affinité, Maîtrise and Amplitude name separate mechanics and need their own anchors. Empty parent headings are not meaningful hover targets.
Tension at three triggers Revers; distinguish Echo, personal Work and family magic, and Dormancy from mundane Stress.

One Maison and one active Faveur per Daemon; the Duke grants a patronal favor, not the Divinity imprint. Belial, Lucifer and Mephisto here are Divinity section headers, not independent Faveur mechanics. Abrasax refers narrowly to Spectre de Mageius.

Éveil differs from Révélation and from the V/SR/R transitions. Aura is an Angelus-specific reserve; Auréole recharges it, and Arbre de Vie governs the connection. Trône, Vertu and Domination are Natures, not hierarchical ranks; Séraphin is an exceptional rank.

The five SR/R profiles are Elyë, Whurten, Ashyll, Thulkar and Azménorien. Their free physiology and magic access do not grant extra attacks, free flight or spells; 53 talents remain in Builder. Cultures and networks belong to the companion Exilés page.
Famine Blanche: Loge d’Écume transmet des Rites sans accorder automatiquement les Dons. La Rupture dépend de la Nature initiale; ses formes relèvent du Bestiaire.
Deimonisme, Longinus, Faux, Fontaine et Œil Blanc sont des voies distinctes. Les Deimons ne fournissent ni serviteurs gratuits ni PA; leur corruption ne supprime pas leur Nature.
Division agit sur des propriétés existantes. Retour fissile de Nucléomancie ne remplace pas Souillure; Psycolors relèvent du Bestiaire.
Éden Gris est une institution et ses grades ne sont pas des PTV. La Bascule fixe une Finalité dépendant de la trajectoire, sans progression PJ après Rupture.
Anciennes mutations ne prouvent pas une Corruption héréditaire. Les Maîtres des Abominations sont un statut cultuel; les Cycles sont après Rupture.
Sombre Culte, Dagon, Telipinu et Horde Abyssale sont des foyers distincts. Horde Abyssale ne constitue pas un arbre PTV et les Grands Thuliens relèvent du Bestiaire.
